# Pinned hydro format fixture

Source: `kimjeon-il/world-map` commit `c0bd31d13dc8495593d78cf51f7cc195de7c9469`.
The files in `source/` are byte-for-byte copies; `git hash-object` must match:

| Local file | Upstream path | Git blob SHA |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hydro-tile-worker.js` | `assets/js/workers/hydro-tile-worker.js` | `2974a78862ce0eb1386061c06341b55c8eabb7ca` |
| `hydro-shard-store.js` | `assets/js/workers/hydro-shard-store.js` | `37c344da429b87df4b2e85f0229877d606bd4c65` |
| `hydro-tile-window.js` | `assets/js/modules/hydro-tile-window.js` | `2c84b806777eae4229166903db6b9dda8e93811b` |
| `earcut.min.js` | `assets/js/vendor/earcut.min.js` | `79cf67e1001350a4da6d9e51c6421da06cd7b556` |
| `geographic-boundary-core.js` | `assets/js/workers/geographic-boundary-core.js` | `3c97ed6732be0c51308f33199a8c7138abe2c515` |

The upstream manifest at `assets/data/hydro/v0.13.1/manifest.json` has blob
`67c648a207f4b26d69f0a86243e88c54b9241a2e`. Its version, schema,
relative-path layout and stage grid are reflected by the miniature manifest
here. We deliberately do not commit the 12 MiB world dataset to this repository.

`tools/generate-m5-hydro-fixture.py` uses the binary encoding and pack/index
layouts from upstream `tools/build-hydro-tiles.py` (blob
`09bd97313f42364cfe3b4951c220fc4758205be8`, encoder lines 1484–1581,
pack/index writer lines 1637–1729). The tiny fixture has six physical records:
normal and border-aligned rivers, simple and holed lakes, and two fragments of
one logical river in distinct packs. `expected.json` is generated by calling
the pinned **web worker decoder**, not by the Python encoder.

Regeneration:

```bash
python3 tools/generate-m5-hydro-fixture.py
node tools/m5-hydro-oracle.mjs --write-golden --fixture-only
node tools/m5-hydro-oracle.mjs --fixture-only
```

The full `--fixture-only` check runs without Qt. Native probe parity will be
registered after the parser and native probe are implemented. Original source
notices and licenses are retained with their pinned upstream files; the vendored
Earcut runtime remains subject to its upstream license.
